brief:
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's strong showing in recent elections undermines liberal Zionists' political standing and complicates their stated approach to Israeli governance, Mondoweiss reported. The result intensifies debate within Israeli politics over the direction of the state and its policies.

Liberal Zionists have sought to position themselves as an alternative to right-wing governance while maintaining support for core Zionist principles. Netanyahu's electoral success raises questions about the viability of that political middle ground in Israeli politics.
dek: Netanyahu’s strong showing in the Israeli elections is a blow to liberal Zionists and their effort to continue to deny Israeli apartheid.
title: Netanyahu's election victory challenges liberal Zionist political strategy
